name: Discover Rolf's Fate
label: Quest
description: In eastern Elwynn, two Stormwind guards are missing near Stone Cairn Lake. Malakai's half-eaten remains and webbed tracks lead toward a murloc village…

clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Elwynn, two Stormwind guards are missing near Stone Cairn Lake. Malakai's half-eaten remains and webbed tracks lead toward a murloc village, where the search for Rolf continues.

Guard Thomas sent patrols around eastern Elwynn Forest as threats grew, but Malakai and Rolf vanished near Stone Cairn Lake. Malakai's half-eaten remains lie by the shore. Webbed footprints pressed into the mud lead east along the water's edge, straight to a ramshackle murloc camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake. In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
